title: TSMC Advanced Packaging Capacity Expansion
summary: TSMC is rapidly scaling CoWoS and SoIC packaging capacity to meet AI chip demand. Expansion involves new fab lines in Taiwan and potential Arizona buildout.

title: OPEC+ Output Restraint Unwind
summary: OPEC+ members are signaling readiness to gradually restore production cuts made in 2024, putting downward pressure on crude benchmarks.

title: European Electricity Market Stress — EDF Reactor Maintenance
summary: EDF's unplanned reactor maintenance schedule reduced France's nuclear output through summer 2026. Spot electricity prices in France and Germany remain elevated relative to 2025 baseline.
